name: IRON SIEGE · WAR-TORN FRONT
summary: Black sky, hazy Earth on the horizon, low warm sun and dust haze; shell-cratered, scorched, tread-tracked grey regolith; HESCO-ringed armoured habs, scaffolded O2 towers and a floodlit supply pad; trees become charred stumps and scrap; Parasite creep, pustules and spires; printed tactical paper map.
